champion.tips: EZREAL TIPS AND TRICKS Use your abilities as frequently as possible to stack your Tear of the Goddess. The quicker you complete this item- the better. Don’t use your E aggressively unless the enemy has their core abilities on cooldown. Using it aggressively will make it easier for you to get killed if you use it when their abilities are up. To destroy towers quickly and get more gold from tower plates, you can use your W on the tower and follow it up with an auto-attack.
champion.builds: THE BEST EZREAL BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ezreal Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Press the Attack as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Trinity Force as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Manamune. For your last 3 items, you should build Spear of Shojin, Serylda's Grudge and finish with Bloodthirster. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 50.5% winrate over 57 759 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ezreal Bot build would be to take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Trinity Force, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Manamune as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Spear of Shojin, Serylda's Grudge and Bloodthirster. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 50.4% win rate over 27 923 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Trinity Force as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Manamune as a third item. You want to finish the build with Spear of Shojin, Serylda's Grudge and Bloodthirster. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 51.0% win rate across 27 649 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Ezreal Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, First Strike, Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight as your primary rune tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Trinity Force as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Manamune as third item. The last 3 options are Spear of Shojin, Serylda's Grudge and Bloodthirster. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 45.6% win rate over 3 085 matches played. Situational Ezreal Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ezreal build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ezreal runes page.
